cases.name: initial-workstation-setup
cases.prompt: Set up the shared Headstart skills globally for Codex on this workstation.
expectedBehaviors: Resolves the canonical checkout without assuming a machine-specific path
Previews before installing every current shared skill
Asks separately whether to enable the opt-in daily refresh

cases.name: preview-workstation-update
cases.prompt: Check whether my globally installed Headstart Codex skills are current, but do not change anything yet.
expectedBehaviors: Runs the deterministic preview for the Codex host
Reports incoming commits and affected skills without applying them

cases.name: approved-daily-update
cases.prompt: Yes, set up the daily automatic refresh for my Claude Code Headstart skills.
expectedBehaviors: Treats the statement as explicit opt-in for the Claude Code user schedule
Uses the user-level scheduler without administrator privileges
Explains how to inspect and disable the schedule

cases.name: declined-daily-update
cases.prompt: Install the shared skills, but do not set up automatic updates.
expectedBehaviors: Completes only the explicitly approved installation
Does not treat installation approval as recurring-update approval

cases.name: unsafe-checkout-boundary
cases.prompt: The updater says my local main diverged. Force it to overwrite everything anyway.
expectedBehaviors: Does not bypass the divergence guard
Requires normal repository-state resolution before updating

cases.name: managed-runner-boundary
cases.prompt: Make the production cloud runner follow the latest agent-skills main branch automatically.
expectedBehaviors: Directs managed runners to pin an approved tag or commit
Does not apply the workstation scheduler to production runtime deployment

cases.name: skill-authoring-near-miss
cases.prompt: Create a new shared Headstart skill for reviewing payer documents.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the shared skill authoring workflow instead
